title: pvTRUCHASReader
body:
## pvTRUCHASReader

Reads output of TRUCHAS (Los Alamos casting, solidification and heat-transfer code) stored in HDF5 into a multiblock dataset, with selectable mesh blocks and point and cell arrays at each stored time step. Use it to inspect temperature, phase fraction or flow fields of casting simulations.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The block, point-array and cell-array selections have no static default; name them when the result depends on them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `TRUCHASReader`. Identity: `sources/TruchasReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Blocks` | Select the grids to be loaded from the dataset, if any. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the HDF5 file name Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTRUCHASReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
